[SWS_DM_00926] Event memory overflow notifier on clear
⌈
If an over-
flow has occurred, as specified in [SWS_DM_00923]), for a particular event mem-
ory, the DM shall, after the next execution of clear all DTCs for that particular event
memory, call the corresponding overflow notification function for that event memory,
which was registered via the function ara::diag::DTCInformation::SetEvent-
MemoryOverflowNotifier for this event memory instance, with the parameter
value set to false.
